title: 第十三章：黑吃黑
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

电话那边是一个外国人，他一听就知道是谁，以前有经常联系。

正是他订的那批军火，可是有一个不好的消息，那就是在到达国内后遇上了黑吃黑，正是隔壁的明珠。

也不知道是怎么回事，另一伙黑帮得到这批货的消息，在半路截了。还好的是，因为国内禁枪很严重，所以北极熊那伙人占了很大的优势，但是也只是僵持在那，他们也不想因为这批货造成大片伤亡，到时把人引来就麻烦了。

苏行枫这边一想，TMD这不是耍赖嘛！要是真开起战来你们还想截货？不打得你半死啊！这算哪门子截货啊？

所以他了解到情况后，也不怎么急，在这边安排好一切后，自己就开着H1去了。

他开的不是很快，晚上十一点才到那，找了个酒店住下休息了一晚。

第二天他联系了他们，知道他们被逼到一个码头仓库中，他查了一下导航，就按就导航去了那。

当他来的那时，可以远远的看到那一片安静的可怕，没有闲人也没有机器轰鸣声，附近全是凶神恶煞拿着家伙的人。

“伊万，我的兄弟，你们好像是被包饺子了啊！哈哈！”

“狼，他还好意思说，你们就这么欢迎我们这么外国宾客的吗？你到是到了没啊？”

“我就在这外面，看到这里这么多人我怕是进不来啊！”

“你就在这装吧！你什么人我还不知道？”

“好吧！兄弟我这就来，不过我要你配合我一下，很简单的.......”

确实和他说的一样很简单。

他开着自己的H1直接冲了进去，明珠这边的人虽然看起来多，但也没多少枪，炸弹就更不用说了，自己的是防弹的也不怕啊！没有人不怕死的，见到他冲过来后全怕了，所以也没人拦得住，这些黑帮也没想到谁会这么大胆这么闯啊！所以也就没有路障。

当他来到那个仓库时，仓库的门！人家里面可真是真家伙呢！

苏行枫进去后直接让伊万这些人就这么出去，也没怕那些黑帮做什么。然后他自己在那看了一下，把那里面所有摄像头打掉，看了一下没什么纰漏后，把那批属于自己的军火收进戒子中。

最后留下几个高爆炸药，等他出来后按了一下遥控器。

‘嘣嘣~~’

随着几声高爆炸药的巨响，这个仓库也炸了。

当伊万听到这声响后才真真知道，这是多么简单粗爆啊！

当响声过后就是黑帮围了过来，这个时候就连苏行枫也只能下车投降了，他知道那些黑帮不敢对他们怎么样，所以他事先就计划好了这些。

伊万也知道他的计划，所以一行十六个人都双手抱头，站在那等着那些黑帮过来。

“小老弟，还是你行啊！这一炸什么都没了啊！真是可惜啊！哎！你就说说你是谁吧！”

这时一个四十岁左右的中年男人走上前对着他说。

“不知怎么称呼？”

“江湖上大家给面子，叫我一声豹爷，你也这样叫着吧！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was a foreigner on the other side of the phone. He knew who he was as soon as he heard it, and he had been in frequent contact with me in the past.

It was the batch of arms he ordered, but there was bad news, that is, after arriving in the country, he encountered a gangster who was the pearl next door.

I don’t know what happened, but another group of gangsters got the news about this batch of goods and intercepted them halfway.Fortunately, due to the strict ban on firearms in the country, the polar bear group had a great advantage, but they were just stuck there. They didn't want to cause a lot of casualties because of this batch of goods. It would be troublesome to attract people.

Su Xingfeng thought about it, damn, isn't this a lie?If a war really breaks out, do you still want to cut off the goods?I'll beat you half to death!What kind of cut-off is this?

So after he learned about the situation, he was not too anxious. After arranging everything here, he drove the H1.

He didn't drive very fast. He didn't get there until eleven o'clock in the evening and found a hotel to stay and rest for the night.

He contacted them the next day and learned that they were forced to a dock warehouse. He checked the navigation and navigated there.

When he arrived, he could see the terrifying silence from a distance. There were no idle people and no roar of machines. The area was full of men with menacing looks and weapons.

"Ivan, my brother, you seem to have been tricked! Haha!"

"Wolf, he still has the nerve to say, is this how you welcome foreign guests like us? Have you arrived yet?"

"I'm right outside here. Seeing so many people here, I'm afraid I won't be able to get in!"

"Just pretend here! I don't know who you are yet?"

"Okay! Brother, I'll come right away, but I want you to cooperate with me. It's very simple..."

It's really as simple as he said.

He drove his H1 and rushed in. Although there seemed to be a lot of people on Mingzhu's side, they didn't have many guns, let alone bombs. He was not afraid because his own was bulletproof!No one is not afraid of death. They were all scared when they saw him charging towards him, so no one could stop him. These gangsters did not expect who would be so bold and aggressive!So there are no roadblocks.

When he came to that warehouse, the door of the warehouse!There are really real guys in there!

After Su Xingfeng entered, he just let Ivan and the others go out without fear of what those gangsters would do.Then he took a look there himself, knocked off all the cameras there, and after checking that nothing was wrong, he put the batch of arms that belonged to him into the ring.

Finally, he left a few high explosives behind and pressed the remote control after he came out.

‘Boom boom~~’

With several loud blasts of high explosives, the warehouse also exploded.

When Ivan heard this sound, he really realized how simple and crude it was!

After the noise, the gangsters surrounded them. At this time, even Su Xingfeng had no choice but to get out of the car and surrender. He knew that the gangsters did not dare to do anything to them, so he had planned this in advance.

Ivan also knew his plan, so a group of sixteen people stood there with their hands on their heads, waiting for the gangsters to come over.

"Little brother, you'd better do it! Nothing will be lost in this explosion! What a pity! Hey! Just tell me who you are!"

At this time, a middle-aged man about forty years old walked up to him and said to him.

"I don't know what to call it?"

"Everyone in the world, give me face and call me Mr. Bao. You should also call me like that!"
